PFE.headline: Wall Street's Most Accurate Analysts Give Their Take On 3 Health Care Stocks Delivering High-Dividend Yields
PFE.summary: Analysts highlight high-yield healthcare stocks Perrigo (7.09%), Pfizer (5.65%) and CVS Health (2.82%), with updated ratings and news.

PFE.headline: European Commission Approves Combination Therapy Involving Pfizer and Astellas
PFE.summary: The European Commission has granted approval for a treatment regimen based on the Phase 3 Keynote-B15 study, conducted in collaboration with Pfizer and Astellas.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Pilots Cloud-Based LIMS to Accelerate Drug Delivery
PFE.summary: Pfizer is implementing a cloud-based Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) to enhance global medicine delivery and integrate AI capabilities.

PFE.headline: Pfizer and Tempus Advance Collaboration on Biomarker Testing
PFE.summary: Pfizer and Tempus are continuing their joint research efforts to address diagnostic barriers and improve biomarker testing across various treatment landscapes.

PFE.headline: Swiss Pharma Giant Roche Suspends German Capital Commitments Amid Dispute Over Drug Discounts
PFE.summary: Roche halts German investments as chief Daniel Steiners warns Berlin that statutory drug rebates shatter trust in the market.

PFE.headline: Pfizer to Introduce 15 New Pharmaceutical Products in Africa
PFE.summary: Pfizer has announced plans to introduce 15 new pharmaceutical products, including cancer treatments, as part of a broader investment initiative in Africa.
